chunks: Ali, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood al-Raqqi, from a man from his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever escorts the coffin of a believer until he is buried in his grave, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will assign to him seventy angels from the escorts, who will escort him and seek forgiveness for him when he exits from his grave until the Pausing station.

key_terms.الْمَوْقِفِ: The Pausing station (Place of Standing on Judgment Day)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for escorting a believer's funeral procession?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the communal obligation of *tashiyy* (escorting the deceased), promising seventy angels to intercede for the deceased from the grave until the Day of Standing. This specific reward underscores the Shia emphasis on the continuity of spiritual support beyond burial, linking earthly acts of piety to divine intercession in the afterlife. The presence of angels seeking forgiveness highlights the merit of the deceased's faith, which is activated by the community's participation in the funeral rites.

en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood Al Raqqy, from a man from his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The one who escorts a coffin of a Believer until he is buried in his grave, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Allocated seventy escorting Angels to be with him, escorting him and seeking Forgiveness for him, he exits from his grave up to the Pausing station (on the Day of Judgement)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali has narrated from his father and a number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad all from ibn Mahbub from Dawud al- Riqqiy, from a man of his people who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith.

‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, for one’s escorting the dead body of a believing person until it (the dead body) is buried, assigns seventy thousand angels of the escorting ones to escort him (escorting person) and ask forgiveness for him from the time he is taken out of his grave to the station (for Judgment).”’
